title: Great for all your food storage needs!
text: Great for all your food storage needs!. These are really nice quality food storage containers. There are a variety of shapes and sizes which makes it nice for all your storage needs. The tops fit snugly and air tight and help keep food fresher longer. I use the smaller one for taking my lunch to work in and it fits great in my large purse and I have no fear of leaking. This would make a great housewarming or bridal shower gift.

product_metadata.title: SHOMOTE 10 Pieces Glass Food Storage Containers with Lids Airtight, BPA-Free Portion Control Bowls, Lunch Meal Prep, Freezer Microwave Dishwasher Safe
features: 🍒【5 PACK GLASS MEAL PREP CONTAINERS】SHOMOTE glass containers include Rectangle (1) 18 oz, (2) 32 oz. Square (2) 8 oz. (Please allow 0.1"-0.3" in differences due to manual measurements.) Perfect for baby toddler kids adults: take out, leftovers, to go, picnic, portion control, work or school lunch, travel, etc.

🥑【MICROWAVE(Not the lids), DISHWASHER, FREEZER SAFE】You can use them for fridge storage, microwave(not the lids), and dishwasher. Easy to use and easy to clean. It's safe to wash the locking lids in the dishwasher, but high temperatures over a long period of time can deform the silicone sealing strip at the edge of the lid. Please wash the lids by hand as much as possible.

🍤【BPA FREE & LEAK PROOF】SHOMOTE glass storage containers are BPA-Free, leak-proof containers and secure-fitting lids keep food fresh longer and keep odorless. It's made out of borosilicate glass for easy heating and durable in use.

🍓【MEET YOUR NEEDS】These glass containers will be a good helper for meeting your daily food storage needs, for dry food leftover salad sandwich snack fruit soup sauce cookie chip. you can use them for many years.

🍔【WARM TIP】If you receive 3 items not 5 items, please do not worry, because 2 small ones are put inside in 2 large ones. If you have any questions, please contact us. Great holiday thanksgiving christmas gifts.
